critical_evidence.evidence: No borescope is offered or shown. This is the 3.4 M97, the engine most associated with bore scoring.
There is no IMS invoice or engine number. A 2008 M97 normally carries the larger, non-serviceable bearing, and there is no reported IMS entry in the CARFAX.
No fault memory, cam deviation or over-rev printout. This matters especially on a manual with two prior owners and two dealer flips.
The listing claims a power soft top, but the car is photographed only with the hardtop installed. There is no top-cycling video and no drain or footwell photos.
CARFAX shows only a coolant flush at Porsche of Plano 03/02/2019 (31,744 mi). There is no reported water pump, thermostat, expansion tank or front radiator/condenser entry on an 18-year-old car.

documentation.rationale: Identity and terms are strong: VIN matches the decode and CARFAX, the factory option list is itemised, the price is fixed, and title and owner history are clean in CARFAX. Maintenance evidence is thin. There are two Porsche-dealer entries (2014, 2019) and a 2026 KDI visit of unknown content, no invoices, and no reported entries during owner 2's five years. There is nothing on IMS, borescope, cooling parts or the soft top.

condition.rationale: The studio photos show clean paint, clear headlights, even ride height and good-looking tires, but this is cosmetic evidence only. Nothing establishes engine bore condition, IMS, cooling-system age, leaks, tire dates or the soft-top mechanism. Low mileage does not substitute for age-related service on an 18-year-old M97.

price_value.rationale: Asking $34,700 is above the $33,125 fair-value mid, toward the top of the $26,227-$35,783 range. The premium is justified only by low mileage and options, not by documented IMS, borescope or cooling work. CARFAX shows the car offered by this dealer since 06/11/2026, which suggests negotiating room.

mission_fit.rationale: It is a manual, fun, year-round-capable car with a hardtop. However, Porsche, the Boxster included, is on the buyer's active exclusions and is deferred to 2027-28 for higher purchase and maintenance cost. A 987.1 M97 is not the low-maintenance, easy-resale bridge the mission describes.

logistics.rationale: The established dealer in Federal Way, WA is about 740 miles away. Several Porsche independent shops in the Seattle area make a mobile or shop PPI feasible, though permission is unconfirmed. Fly-and-drive home on I-5 is straightforward, and a 50-state 2008 gasoline car should be smog-feasible in California.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: This is a desirable spec: 3.4 S, 6-speed manual, factory colour-matched hardtop, PASM, Sport Exhaust, bi-xenons and 19in Carrera Classics, low miles, apparently stock. Arctic Silver over black is classic but common rather than rare.

positives: Clean CARFAX: two personal owners, a guaranteed clean title, no reported accident, damage or total loss, and no odometer issue. The listed mileage of 37,918 agrees with CARFAX's 37,856 (04/2026).
Desirable factory spec: 3.4 S, 6-speed manual, colour-matched hardtop, PASM, Sport Exhaust, bi-xenon and 19in Carrera Classics, apparently unmodified.
Porsche of Plano (03/2019, 31,744 mi) logged a coolant flush, brake fluid, serpentine belt and spark plugs. Porsche Dallas did brake fluid in 2014.
The first owner held the car almost 13 years with regular Texas safety inspections; there was no recall or warranty activity of concern.
Dealer listing with VIN and itemised options. The car has sat on the lot since 06/11/2026, which is negotiation leverage.

ppi_focus: Borescope all six cylinder walls, especially the 3.4 M97 cylinders prone to scoring.
Durametric/PIWIS: fault memory, cam deviation values, over-rev ranges 1-6.
Cut-open oil filter for ferrous or IMS debris; check oil level and consumption history.
RMS and IMS cover area and bellhousing for active oil leaks; AOS and cold-start smoke.
Water pump weep, expansion tank cracks or crust, coolant age and condition, front condensers for debris and corrosion.
Soft top: full cycle, cables and drive blocks, hydraulic leaks, drains clear, footwells and under-seat modules dry.
Tire DOT dates and condition; front control arm/coffin arm bushings, top mounts and PASM function on an 18-year-old chassis.
Clutch engagement point and DMF judder from a stop; paint meter for undisclosed bodywork.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: the buyer chooses to lift the Porsche exclusion now and a clean borescope, filter cut and over-rev report come back.
Up: the price is negotiated substantially toward or below the fair-value mid after inspection findings.
Up: KDI and owner-2 invoices show recent fluids, and cooling or IMS work is documented.
Down: any bore scoring, ferrous filter debris or high over-rev counts, which are dealbreakers.
Down: wet footwells or a malfunctioning soft top, or the dealer refusing an independent PPI.
evidence.mission_note: A manual, open-top, low-mileage Boxster S fits the 'fun daily with a point of view' spirit. However, Porsche is explicitly deferred to 2027-28 and the M97 engine risk and maintenance profile contradict the reliable, inexpensive-to-run bridge brief.
evidence.rationale: The VIN, decode and CARFAX agree on a 2008 Boxster S 3.4 with two personal owners, a guaranteed clean title, and no reported accident or odometer issue. The listed 37,918 miles is consistent with CARFAX's 37,856. Documented maintenance is thin: a Porsche of Plano visit in 03/2019 (coolant, brake fluid, belt, plugs), brake fluid in 2014, quick-lube inspections, and an unspecified KDI Service visit after the dealer bought the car. There are no reported service entries at all during the Kansas owner's five years. The photos show a cosmetically clean, unmodified car with the hardtop fitted. They cannot speak to bore condition, IMS, cooling-system age, leaks, tire dates or the soft top, all of which remain open. The asking price of $34,700 sits above the $33,125 fair-value mid. The car has been offered by this dealer since 06/11/2026. Separately from condition, Porsche is on the buyer's active exclusions list for this cycle.
evidence.next_action: Before anything else, confirm with Jason whether the Porsche exclusion stands. If he lifts it, request the KDI invoice, engine number and tire dates from West State Motorsport, and get written permission for an independent Seattle-area Porsche PPI with borescope and over-rev scan.
